title: Reactome Multi-Omics Pathway Analysis webinar reaches record attendance
body:
##  Reactome Multi-Omics Pathway Analysis webinar reaches record attendance 

![Reactome GSA](/uploads/about/news/Reactome_GSA.png)On June 2, 2021, Dr. Johannes Griss presented "[A guide to multiomics pathway analysis](<https://www.ebi.ac.uk/training/events/guide-multi-omics-pathway-analysis/>)" to a record audience of 572 participants as part of the [EMBL-EBI webinar series](<https://www.ebi.ac.uk/training/on-demand?facets=type:Recorded%20webinar>). The [seminar recording](<https://embl-ebi.cloud.panopto.eu/Panopto/Pages/Viewer.aspx?id=34b9ac41-e7c6-46d5-986c-ad3b00c902d6>) and [training materials](<https://drive.google.com/file/d/1DjH91Zv_1GyiAMd5Xq3zlnqeKacaK_UX/view>), which are now available online, provides insight into performing comparative multi-omics pathway analyses using the ReactomeGSA platform. We want to take this opportunity to thank all those that took part in the training webinar. If you are interested in learning more about Reactome or if you have any additional questions, please [help@reactome.org](<mailto:help@reactome.org>).
